ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral asymmetrical mottling. The left lobe contains a large central high-intensity region interspersed with dark linear striations. The right lobe features a broad high-intensity area towards the distal tip, bisected by several prominent, near-vertical dark bands and diagonal streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated profile along the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying from low-frequency broad undulations to high-frequency jagged serrations, particularly on the inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes leading toward the notch; the leading/outer edges show a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular nodes (approx. 6-8 units) visible on the far left distal tip; scattered small white circular punctations within the dark-pigmented central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct linear pixel disruptions. Right lobe shows a prominent near-vertical dark line and several parallel diagonal scratches. Left lobe displays a network of fine, intersecting linear marks across the white pigmented field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical evidence of barnacle colonization on the upper left lobe tip; extensive linear scarring (likely rake marks) across the high-intensity regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'grid-like' intersecting pigment pattern located on the inner-mid quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
